test_debug_features: Internal loopback (MCR.LOOP=1) for fault isolation; SOUT internally drives SIN; modem outputs drive modem inputs.
Break, parity, overrun, framing error simulation through loopback + register manipulation.
FIFO reset bits (FCR.RX_FIFO_RESET, FCR.TX_FIFO_RESET) for in-chip BIST equivalent.
Complete LSR status reporting allows software self-test of all framing / error paths.
Master Reset (MR pin) sets a known reset state per Table I.

spec_provided_observability.name: LSR.DR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Data Ready — character available in RBR / RX FIFO.

spec_provided_observability.name: LSR.RFE
spec_provided_observability.purpose: RX FIFO contains at least one error (FIFO mode).

spec_provided_observability.name: IIR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Identifies highest-priority pending interrupt + FIFO-enabled status.

spec_provided_observability.name: MSR delta bits
spec_provided_observability.purpose: DCTS / DDSR / TERI / DDCD record modem-input transitions since last read.

interrupt_sources.trigger: RX data available or FIFO trigger level reached.
Character timeout — RX FIFO non-empty + no new char within 4 character times.

interrupt_request: INTR pin (active HIGH) is the OR of all enabled interrupt sources; IIR identifies the highest-priority pending source.
notes: The 16450/16550 family was the de-facto standard PC serial-port UART; the loopback diagnostic + status registers make it self-testable through software alone — historically important for BIOS power-on self-test (POST).
